items.title: Intel expands new game-boosting iBOT software with seven more games, up to a 27% improvement — Team Blue claims 12% average jump in newly-supported titles
items.description: Intel is expanding its performance-boosting iBOT feature with seven new games.

items.title: macOS 27 Golden Gate Goes Official With Liquid Glass Design Changes And A Ton Of Optimizations To Improve Performance And Responsiveness
items.description: As expected, Apple has retained its Liquid Glass UI with the introduction of macOS 27 Golden Gate, the newest update to the company’s desktop operating system, and there are a ton of changes incorporated. Most importantly, the technology firm has brought in a bevy of performance improvements, which
items.tldr: macOS 27 Golden Gateが正式発表され、Liquid Glassデザインを維持しつつ、多くのパフォーマンス向上とレスポンス改善が行われました。

items.title: Valheim Leaves Early Access After Five Years This September as 1.0 Brings a New Biome and Adds PS5 and Switch 2 Versions
items.description: Early access survival game Valheim, from developer Iron Gate and publisher Coffee Stain Publishing will finally launch out of early access later this year, with a 1.0 release date officially set for September 9, 2026. After its early access launch back in 2021, this 1.0 release marks the end of five
items.tldr: TL;DR: サバイバルゲーム「Valheim」が2026年9月9日に1.0版として正式リリースされ、PS5およびSwitch 2版が追加される。

items.title: Maybe in “100 Years,” GenAI Could Create Art, Says Hideo Kojima, But He’s Not Interested in it Either Way
items.description: Hideo Kojima has given what appears to be his final word on Generative AI (GenAI) technology and whether it's something he's really interested in exploring as part of the artistic process and its capability for creating art. Speaking to The Washington Post (spotted by Kotaku), even after a GenAI ver
items.tldr: 小島秀夫は、Generative AI（GenAI）技術がアートを創造する可能性について語り、100年後にはその能力があるかもしれないが、自身はその探求には興味がないと述べた。

items.title: ServeTheHome Turns 17 The Places You Will Go
items.description: ServeTheHome is now 17 years old, starting from posting about using RAID controllers and 2.5" hard drives and taking us all over The post ServeTheHome Turns 17 The Places You Will Go appeared first on ServeTheHome.
items.tldr: ServeTheHomeは17周年を迎え、RAIDコントローラーや2.5インチハードドライブに関する投稿から始まりました。

items.description: At Summer Game Fest 2026, newly established publishing label Paramount Games Studio unveiled TMNT: The Last Ronin, a project in development at PlatinumGames (NieR: Automata, Bayonetta 3, Ninja Gaiden 4). As some of you may recall, we already got such an announcement in March 2023, but back then, the
items.tldr: TMNT: The Last RoninがSummer Game Fest 2026で発表され、PlatinumGamesが開発を担当し、God of WarスタイルのストーリーテリングとMortal Kombat 11のライターが関与していることが明らかになった。

items.title: Most new U.S. AI data centers are being built in drought zones — two-thirds of 809 planned projects set for areas with water shortages
items.description: About two-thirds of the 809 data centers planned across the U.S. are slated for land that has been in drought over the past year.

items.title: Farmer donates land for a park, city sells it for data center development — $10 gift became $10M for city government, with $30M tax expected over next decade
items.description: Texas farmland originally donated in 1999 to be used only as a public park has been sold to a data center developer for $10 million.
items.tldr: 1999年に公園用に寄付されたテキサスの農地が、データセンター開発のために1,000万ドルで売却され、市政府は今後10年間で3,000万ドルの税収を見込んでいる。

items.title: AI-Capable iPhones Reach New Shipment Record But Cannot Realize Their Full Potential, Making WWDC 2026’s Revamped Siri Launch Even More Paramount
items.description: Apple Intelligence was marketed as this incredible on-device AI service that would transform iPhones into smarter devices and would offer a compelling reason to upgrade to the newer handsets, but we all know how well that played out. Fortunately, the Cupertino firm has been given another chance at W
items.tldr: AI対応のiPhoneが新たな出荷記録を達成したものの、その潜在能力を十分に発揮できておらず、2026年のWWDCでの改良版Siriの発表がますます重要になっている。

items.title: Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible – why the CPU to GPU ratio is more important than ever for hyperscalers
items.description: The massive AI gold rush has a new bottleneck set in its sights, CPUs. But what's driving the demand? We interview industry experts to find out.
items.tldr: データセンター向けCPUの需要が急増しており、その要因はAIエージェントにある。ハイパースケーラーにとってCPUとGPUの比率がこれまで以上に重要になっている。

items.title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra Delayed Again, Won’t Arrive Until 2027 as Amy Hennig’s “Relatively Small” Team is Given “Time to Cook”
items.description: Last week, Skydance New Media and Skydance Interactive were officially brought together under one umbrella as Paramount Skydance revealed Paramount Game Studios, with Tony Driscoll running the division and veteran creator Amy Hennig in the creative director's chair. While part of that reveal was tha
items.tldr: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydraの発売が再度延期され、2027年まで届かないことが発表されました。これは、エイミー・ヘニングの「比較的小さな」チームに開発の時間を与えるためです。

items.title: Xbox Games Showcase 2026: Everything Announced
items.description: The Xbox Games Showcase returns to the Summer Games Fest season this year, but while the format remains the same, everything at the company has changed. With a new leadership team, led by head Asha Sharma, and the goal of reclaiming fans' goodwill following the disastrous "Everything is an Xbox" cam
items.tldr: TL;DR: Xbox Games Showcase 2026では、新しいリーダーシップのもと、ファンの信頼を取り戻すことを目指し、さまざまな新作ゲームが発表された。

items.title: Ming-Chi Kuo Warns Apple’s Siri Must Outclass Google Gemini at WWDC 2026, Not Just Catch Up After Years of Delay
items.description: Apple's Siri-related test case is finally at hand, and no amount of prevarication will forestall judgement. items.tldr: TL;DR: Ming-Chi Kuoは、Appleが2026年のWWDCでSiriをGoogleのGeminiクラスAIモデルを超えるレベルに引き上げる必要があると警告しています。

items.title: METRO 2039 Debuts First Gameplay Trailer and Locks February 2027 Launch in What’s Going to be Another Crazy Gaming Month
items.description: During the Xbox Games Showcase 2026, developer 4A Games and publisher Deep Silver unveiled the first gameplay trailer and release date of METRO 2039. The new installment in the post-apocalyptic, story-driven first-person shooter franchise will launch in February 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox S
items.tldr: METRO 2039がXbox Games Showcase 2026で初のゲームプレイトレーラーを公開し、2027年2月にPC、PlayStation 5、Xbox S向けに発売されることが発表されました。

items.title: Apple’s M5 Ultra Could Make A Surprise Appearance At WWDC 2026 To Deliver A Solid AI Push, Rumored Specifications Include 1,000GB/s Bandwidth, 36-Core CPU & More
items.description: In the AI race, there’s no question that Apple is trailing behind its rivals, despite the fact that it has been enjoying the past few quarters thanks to its hardware sales going through the roof. Fortunately, WWDC 2026 could put an end to all the doubters who have concluded that the technology giant
items.tldr: AppleのM5 UltraがWWDC 2026で登場する可能性があり、1,000GB/sの帯域幅や36コアCPUを備えた仕様が噂されています。これにより、AppleはAI分野での競争力を強化することが期待されています。

items.title: Disgruntled ASML employees threaten to boycott Elon Musk conference appearance — staff express ire at political involvement and 'Nazi sympathies'
items.description: ASML has confirmed that a group of disgruntled workers is pushing back hard against an invitation for Elon Musk to address the equipment maker’s closed annual tech conference.
items.tldr: ASMLの不満を抱える従業員が、エロン・マスクの年次技術会議への招待に反発し、政治的関与や「ナチスへの同情」を理由にボイコットを示唆しています。

items.title: Travlfi JourneyGo 5G mobile hotspot review – Affordably priced, but lacking in performance and features
items.description: The Travlfi JourneyGo 5G makes a good first impression with its $299 price and lightweight design, but that shine wears off quickly.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Travlfi JourneyGo 5Gは299ドルの手頃な価格と軽量デザインで初印象は良いが、性能と機能が不足しているため、すぐにその魅力が薄れてしまう。

items.title: Four suspects identified in Finland undersea cable damage investigation — criminal case referred to prosecutors for consideration of charges
items.description: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation has concluded its criminal investigation into the damage to two undersea telecommunications cables in the Gulf of Finland on December 31st.
items.tldr: フィンランド国家捜査局は、12月31日にフィンランド湾で発生した2本の海底通信ケーブルの損傷に関する刑事調査を終了し、4人の容疑者を特定、起訴の検討のために検察に事件を送致した。

items.title: Bag a huge $308 saving on a two-year ExpressVPN Advanced sub and get four bonus months on top for free — 78% discount gets you this fast no-logs VPN service with support for 12 simultaneous connections for just $83
items.description: Save over $300 on this two-year ExpressVPN Advanced subscription, with support for 12 simultaneous devices, advanced web protection, and a bunch of other tools for just $83.72, with four months extra for free.
items.tldr: ExpressVPNの2年間のAdvancedサブスクリプションが78%オフの$83で購入でき、12台の同時接続をサポートし、さらに4ヶ月の無料期間が付いています。

items.title: Nvidia and SK hynix ink multi-year memory co-development and supply agreement — seeks to address extended development cycles
items.description: Nvidia and SK hynix have inked a multi-year collaboration agreement under which the companies will co-develop next-generation memory technologies for Nvidia's upcoming platforms and SK hynix will supply them to Nvidia.
items.tldr: NvidiaとSK hynixは、次世代メモリ技術を共同開発し、SK hynixがNvidiaに供給するための複数年にわたる協力契約を締結した。

items.title: Meta Blocks NSO Group's New WhatsApp Phishing Attack, Files Contempt Order
items.description: Meta on Monday said it detected and blocked spear-phishing attempts linked to Israeli spyware vendor NSO Group. In addition, the tech giant said it's filing a federal court contempt order against the company for violating a permanent injunction that barred it from targeting WhatsApp and its users. "
items.tldr: Metaは、イスラエルのスパイウェア企業NSO Groupに関連するスピアフィッシング攻撃を検出し阻止したと発表し、同社がWhatsAppとそのユーザーを標的にすることを禁じた恒久的な差し止め命令に違反したとして連邦裁判所に対する contempt order を提出することを明らかにした。

items.title: Critical Zcash Vulnerability Found and Fixed
items.description: If you’re a user—owner?—of this cryptocurrency, this is important: On May 29, the security researcher Taylor Hornby found a critical vulnerability in Zcash Orchard privacy pool using Claude Opus 4.8. The Zcash team hired Hornby specifically to look for this kind of issue. He found
items.tldr: ZcashのOrchardプライバシープールに重大な脆弱性が発見され、修正された。セキュリティ研究者テイラー・ホーンビーがこの問題を特定し、Zcashチームは彼を雇って脆弱性を探していた。

items.title: Gogs patches critical zero-day enabling remote code execution
items.description: Gogs has patched a critical security zero-day flaw that can allow attackers to compromise Internet-facing instances and access any repositories (including private ones). [...]
items.tldr: Gogsは、リモートコード実行を可能にする重大なゼロデイ脆弱性を修正し、インターネットに接続されたインスタンスを攻撃者が侵害し、プライベートリポジトリを含む任意のリポジトリにアクセスできるリスクを軽減しました。

items.title: 'Hades' Campaign Against PyPI Puts New Spin on Shai-Hulud
items.description: The latest attacks, which hit 37 PyPI wheels and 19 code packages, show a continued evolution of the persistent software supply chain threat.
items.tldr: TL;DR: HadesによるPyPIに対する攻撃が37のPyPIホイールと19のコードパッケージを標的にし、ソフトウェアサプライチェーンの脅威が進化していることを示しています。

items.title: Critical UniFi OS bug lets hackers gain root without authentication
items.description: Attackers can chain three already fixed vulnerabilities in the Ubiquiti UniFi OS server to execute remote code with root privileges and without authentication. [...]
items.tldr: UniFi OSのサーバーに存在する修正済みの脆弱性3つを組み合わせることで、攻撃者が認証なしにルート権限でリモートコードを実行できる重大なバグが発見されました。

items.title: Critical Check Point VPN Flaw Exploited to Bypass Passwords in IKEv1 Setups
items.description: Check Point has warned of active exploitation of a critical vulnerability impacting Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments that are configured to use the deprecated IKEv1 key exchange protocol. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-50751 (CVSS score: 9.3), is a case of a logic flow weaknes
items.tldr: Check Pointは、廃止されたIKEv1キー交換プロトコルを使用するリモートアクセスVPNおよびモバイルアクセスの設定に影響を与える重大な脆弱性（CVE-2026-50751、CVSSスコア9.3）が悪用されていると警告しています。

items.title: Reducing security operations complexity with Wazuh Cloud
items.description: Security teams are increasingly overwhelmed by alert fatigue, infrastructure maintenance, and complex hybrid environments. This article explores how Wazuh Cloud helps simplify SIEM/XDR operations through managed infrastructure, automated scaling, and AI-driven security analysis. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: Wazuh Cloudは、マネージドインフラストラクチャ、オートスケーリング、AI駆動のセキュリティ分析を通じて、SIEM/XDR操作の複雑さを軽減し、セキュリティチームのアラート疲れやインフラメンテナンスの負担を軽減します。

items.title: AI Phishing Is Crushing SOCs with Alert Volume: How to Reduce Tier 1 Overload
items.description: Phishing has always been a numbers game. AI has turned it into a volume machine. Attackers can now create convincing emails, fake login pages, and tailored lures in minutes. Every polished message adds another case for Tier 1 to review, another link to inspect, and another alert that cannot be dismi
items.tldr: AIを利用したフィッシング攻撃が急増しており、SOCのTier 1アナリストは膨大なアラートに圧倒されています。攻撃者は短時間で信頼性の高いメールや偽のログインページを生成できるため、対策が求められています。

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Instagram Account Hacks, Android Zero-Day, GitHub Worm and More
items.description: Monday again. The weekend was meant to be quiet. It wasn't. Last week had poisoned packages, a broken AI helper, and a worm tearing through repos. The ugly part: basic tricks still worked. A chatbot got fooled. A bot token got leaked inside the malware. The same old mistakes showed up again. And whi
items.tldr: TL;DR: 先週はInstagramアカウントのハッキング、Androidのゼロデイ脆弱性、GitHub上のワームなどが発生し、基本的なセキュリティの失敗が再び明らかになった。

items.title: Check Point links VPN zero-day attacks to Qilin ransomware gang
items.description: Israeli cybersecurity company Check Point has released security updates to patch a critical flaw affecting Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments, which was exploited in zero-day attacks. [...]
items.tldr: Check Pointは、リモートアクセスVPNとモバイルアクセスの展開に影響を与える重大な脆弱性を修正するセキュリティアップデートを発表し、この脆弱性がQilinランサムウェアグループによるゼロデイ攻撃に悪用されたことを明らかにしました。

items.title: The Hardest Fork
items.description: Mythos is real. I know a big chunk of the industry thinks it's a marketing stunt, and I get why. I get it. But I've seen the findings, and they're bad. These aren't "whoops, this line right here is wrong, and that's RCE." They're novel combinations of a few dozen issues out of thousands of things ev
items.tldr: TL;DR: Mythosは業界の一部からマーケティングスタントと見なされているが、実際の調査結果は深刻な問題を示しており、数千の問題からの新しい組み合わせが存在する。

items.title: Oxford University discloses data breach after careers platform hack
items.description: The University of Oxford disclosed a new data breach last week after being informed by its third-party provider, Group GTI, that its CareerConnect career services platform had been compromised. [...]
items.tldr: オックスフォード大学は、第三者プロバイダーのGroup GTIからの通知を受けて、キャリアサービスプラットフォームCareerConnectがハッキングされデータ侵害が発生したことを公表しました。

items.title: Anthropic’s Project Glasswing Update
items.description: In April, Anthropic initated Project Glasswing. The idea was to let companies use their new model to find and fix vulnerabilities in their own software. It was a fantastic PR move, and so many press outlets have uncritically parroted Anthropic’s claims that it’s now common wisdom that My
items.tldr: Anthropicは4月にProject Glasswingを開始し、企業が自社のソフトウェアの脆弱性を発見・修正するための新しいモデルを提供しています。この取り組みはPR戦略としても注目され、多くのメディアがその主張を無批判に報じています。

items.title: VerdantBamboo Deploys BSD Variant of BRICKSTORM on Linux Appliances
items.description: A China-nexus cyber espionage group has been observed deploying a BSD variant of a known backdoor called BRICKSTORM, as well as two other malware families codenamed PLENET (aka GRIMBOLT) and AGENTPSD to target Linux systems. The activity has been attributed by Volexity to a threat cluster it tracks
items.tldr: 中国のサイバー諜報グループが、Linuxシステムを標的にしたBRICKSTORMのBSDバリアントやPLENET、AGENTPSDという2つのマルウェアファミリーを展開していることが確認されました。

items.title: UNC3753 Used Vishing and Physical Intrusions in U.S. Data Theft Extortion Campaign
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a financially motivated data theft extortion campaign that has targeted dozens of organizations across professional, legal, and financial services in the U.S. between January and May 2026. The activity has been attributed by Google Mandiant and Goo
items.tldr: UNC3753は、2026年1月から5月にかけて、米国のプロフェッショナル、法律、金融サービスの組織を標的にした、音声フィッシング（vishing）と物理的侵入を用いたデータ盗難の恐喝キャンペーンを展開した。

items.title: VS Code Adds 2-Hour Extension Auto-Update Delay to Limit Supply Chain Attacks
items.description: Microsoft has announced that Visual Studio Code (VS Code) will apply a two-hour delay before extensions for the integrated development environment (IDE) are updated automatically to a newer version in an attempt to tackle software supply chain threats. "When automatic updates are enabled, new versio
items.tldr: VS Codeは、自動更新を有効にした場合、拡張機能の更新に2時間の遅延を設けることでソフトウェアサプライチェーン攻撃への対策を強化することを発表しました。

items.title: Over 20,000 Instagram accounts stolen in Meta AI support hack
items.description: Meta has revealed that 20,225 Instagram users had their accounts hijacked in a recent incident where attackers used Meta's AI-powered support system to reset passwords. [...]
items.tldr: Metaは、攻撃者が同社のAIサポートシステムを利用して20,225件のInstagramアカウントを乗っ取ったことを発表しました。

items.title: Hands on with Intelligent Terminal, an AI-powered Windows Terminal
items.description: Microsoft has created an open-source fork of Windows Terminal called "Intelligent Terminal," and it allows you to use AI directly inside Terminal without interfering with the regular session. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、通常のセッションに干渉せずにAIを直接利用できるオープンソースのWindows Terminalのフォーク「Intelligent Terminal」を作成しました。

items.title: C0XMO botnet spreads via DD-WRT router flaw, kills rival malware
items.description: A new variant of the Gafgyt botnet called C0XMO is targeting DD-WRT router firmware and can move to other device types with various CPU architectures. [...]
items.tldr: C0XMOという新しいGafgytボットネットがDD-WRTルーターの脆弱性を利用して拡散し、他のデバイスにも感染する能力を持っています。

items.title: Silent Ransom Group targets law firms with fake IT support calls
items.description: The Silent Ransom Group extortion gang is actively targeting U.S. law firms and professional services organizations in social engineering attacks that often lead to data theft within hours of initial contact, according to a new report by cybersecurity firm Mandiant. [...]
items.tldr: Silent Ransom Groupが米国の法律事務所や専門サービス組織を標的にしたソーシャルエンジニアリング攻撃を行い、初回接触から数時間以内にデータ盗難に至るケースが増加していると、サイバーセキュリティ企業Mandiantの報告が示しています。
